## Problem and result

Describe the problem this change addresses and the behavior or workflow after the change.

## Validation

List the commands and flows you checked, their results, and any checks you could not run. For Android checks, include the API level and ABI using synthetic test data.

## Review notes

Link related issues and mention protocol changes, third-party modifications, or setup needed to reproduce the result.

- [ ] The change has a focused scope.
- [ ] Test data and diagnostic excerpts are synthetic or sanitized.
- [ ] No model weights, native prebuilts, generated artifacts, personal data, secrets, or signing material were added.
- [ ] Applicable third-party licenses and notices are preserved.
